info.name: OpenSearch Custom Tools API
info.description:
Complete API collection for OpenSearch ML Commons Custom Tools feature.

Covers:
- CRUD operations (Create, Get, List, Update, Delete)
- Tool execution via Execute API
- RBAC (Private, Public, Restricted access modes)
- Agent integration (Chat + PER agents with custom tools)
- MCP Server integration (JSON-RPC tool discovery and invocation)

Variables:
- {{base_url}} — OpenSearch URL (default: https://localhost:9200)
- {{admin_user}} / {{admin_pass}} — Admin credentials
- {{user1}} / {{user1_pass}} — Test user 1 (backend_role: role_a)
- {{user2}} / {{user2_pass}} — Test user 2 (backend_role: role_b)
- {{tool_id}} — Auto-set after tool creation
- {{model_id}} — Set after model registration/deployment
- {{chat_agent_id}} / {{per_agent_id}} — Set after agent registration
